outcome: Severe maternal morbidity (transfusion of ≥4 RBC units or ureter/bowel injury)
Neonatal morbidity (Apgar score's < 5 at 5 minutes, mechanical ventilation, or respiratory distress syndrome)
cohort: 109 women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for PAS
finding: Unplanned cesarean hysterectomy among women with PAS occurs in 40% and is associated with significantly higher maternal morbidity.
